item.title: 🌳 Papers in the Park S2E12 — Sat Aug 1, 12:00 PM — Trinity Bellwoods Park
item.description:
Address: Trinity Bellwoods Park Usually inside Trinity Cir, west of the tennis courts, blue tablecloth Toronto, ON Canada
This week, we learn about how people have been saving 90% in FLOPs for VLMs using Visual Token Pruning, while retaining almost (and sometimes even better than) 100% performance. We will be comparing the similarities and differences of 3 such models, all released in the last month. TOPS: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.27161 CRISP: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.16326 EADP: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02484
remember to hydrate and bring water :)
The goal? Simple. Meet up at the park, yap about a paper for a few minutes. We discuss and enjoy the summer weather. Low stakes, come by for a few minutes or…

item.title: Fabric Local MCP en acción: conecta tu primer agente a Fabric — Fri Aug 7, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Microsoft Reactor Toronto Manos a la obra.
En esta sesión instalaremos y configuraremos el Fabric Local MCP Server (GA, open-source) y lo conectaremos a un cliente de IA real: VS Code con GitHub Copilot y Claude Desktop.
Exploraremos las tres categorías de herramientas que expone: documentación de APIs de Fabric, operaciones sobre OneLake y creación de ítems core.
Verás en vivo cómo un agente consulta los esquemas de un Lakehouse, sube archivos a OneLake y genera código fundamentado en las especificaciones reales de Fabric, todo desde lenguaje natural. Al final tendrás tu entorno configurado y listo para las sesiones siguientes.
Pre-requisites: Clona el [repositorio microsoft/mcp](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/fabric/articles/mcp-servers/pro-dev-local/overview-local-mcp-server/?wt.mc_id=1reg_27349_webpage_reactor) antes de la sesión

item.title: 🚐🏛️ Historic Road Trip: Doors Open Burlington + Chuck's Roadhouse 🏛️🚐 — Sat Aug 8, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Toronto Movies & Social Group - Celebrating 14 Years! 🚐🏛️ **Historic Road Trip: Doors Open Burlington!** 🏛️🚐
Join us for an unforgettable **Saturday adventure on August 8** as we head to beautiful Burlington, Ontario for the incredible **Doors Open** event!
